long.title: 12 Animal Myths That Could Actually Get You Hurt (TRUE or FALSE?)
long.comment:
📝 SCORE CHECK: how many did you get out of 12? 👇

Answer key: TRUE = make yourself big for a mountain lion. Everything else was FALSE.

Which one would have gotten YOU hurt? Comment it.
long.description:
TRUE or FALSE? Pee on a jellyfish sting, play dead for every bear, suck out snake venom... some "survival tips" everyone knows are wrong, and one could save you. Guess before the 3-second timer, keep score, and drop your score out of 12 in the comments 👇

Fun general info only: always follow local wildlife and medical guidance.

0:00 Play along
0:24 If a jellyfish stings you, you should pee on it?
1:11 If any bear attacks you, you should play dead?
2:09 You should suck the venom out of a snake bite?
2:48 If a crocodile chases you, run in a zigzag?
3:33 Moose are gentle giants that won't hurt you?
4:16 Jumping into water is a good way to escape angry bees?
4:52 Hippos are slow, lazy animals that won't chase you?
5:32 A rattlesnake always rattles before it bites?
6:10 If you meet a mountain lion, make yourself look as big as you can?
6:53 Ticks jump on you, or drop on you from trees?
7:38 Opossums usually carry rabies?
8:20 That fluffy caterpillar is safe to pet?
9:01 Scores

Subscribe for Part 5: animal facts that sound fake but are totally real.
